res_1.title: Understanding Opioid Neurochemistry & Healing
res_1.description: A scientific overview explaining how opioid receptors reset during recovery and methods to cope with cravings.
res_1.contentBody: In this comprehensive video lecture, clinical neuroscientists discuss how endorphin production stabilizes over months of abstinence, validating the patient's emotional journey.

res_2.title: Walking Away from Alcohol: A Stigma-Free Guide
res_2.description: Practical handbook for overcoming alcohol dependency while maintaining privacy in social and familial environments.
res_2.contentBody: Chapter 1 outlines the social triggers common in family gatherings and offers scripted boundaries for declining drinks without disclosing private medical recovery.

res_3.title: Cannabinoid Receptors and Youth Cognitive Recovery
res_3.description: Empirical study on how the teenage and young adult brain repairs executive functioning after cannabis cessation.
res_3.contentBody: Research demonstrates that sleep quality, working memory, and motivation metrics show marked improvement within 21 days of cessation.

res_4.title: Confidential Family Support & Breaking the Stigma
res_4.description: How families can provide an empathetic, non-punitive support system for loved ones undergoing addiction rehabilitation.
res_4.contentBody: Stigma remains the greatest barrier to recovery. By fostering privacy, patience, and professional medical partnership, recovery rates significantly improve.

res_5.title: Mindfulness, Breathwork, and Relapse Prevention
res_5.description: Guided audio-visual relaxation module to reduce cortisol and manage acute impulse moments.
res_5.contentBody: Step-by-step 4-7-8 breathing and sensory grounding exercises designed to halt neurological flight-or-fight distress.

res_6.title: Seniors & Prescription Medication Safety
res_6.description: Understanding the subtle emergence of opioid dependence in chronic pain management among senior citizens.
res_6.contentBody: Addresses physical dependency versus addiction, dosage tapering strategies, and non-pharmacological pain relief methods.
